t: 'Sephonie' Review: Words Do Not Fail This Evocative 3D Platformer
s: April 24, 2024 - If the goal of the developers at Analgesic Productions is to emphasize the atmosphere of the game’s world over simple tests of skill, it never quite succeeds at making the island into a believable place. While Sephonie has less overt signposting and far fewer collectibles than most of its contemporaries, it can’t shake the lineage of the platformer genre, which deals much more successfully in abstract obstacle courses than coherent spaces.
